thread:
Liam: heads-up — pushed a small change to the Console telemetry page in staging: added per-route sampling + a global "telemetry mode" toggle. want a quick PIi/redaction pass before we flip to beta :eyes:
Anya: nice. can you paste what the toggle actually does under the hood? is it just a client-side filter or are we mutating logs before they hit kafka?
Liam: server-side. the toggle sets a policy that the request pipeline evaluates and either: 1) drops payloads for sampled-out traces, or 2) applies redaction rules and forwards. by default sampling_rate=0.01 for high-volume routes.
Shawn: we should avoid doing full plaintext storage for any sampled items by default. either hash or token-mask everything that looks like PII.
Eva: agreed. legal flagged email/phone/SSN & PHI. also need to ensure embeddings are not stored for user inputs when consent is off.
Anya: can we use salted hashing + schema tags (so we can still group by hashed id but not read the value)? example config:
```json
{
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "sampling_rate": 0.01,
  "redaction_policy": "hash_with_salt",
  "preserve_fields": ["metadata.request_id"],
  "hash_salt_id": "salt-v2"
}
```
Liam: that's what I had in staging. note: hash_salt rotates monthly for prod. need to document rotation implications for any troubleshooting workflows.
Shawn: rotation is fine but call it out — hashed identifiers won't be stable across months which will break long-running dedupe/alert queries. maybe offer an opt-in stable-id feature for ops (auditable).
Eva: legal wants a "consent_exempt" flag for enterprise customers who provide explicit consent or have contractual logging requirements. that should be separate from global sampling.
Anya: UX question — do we expose three toggles in Console: sampling_rate, redaction_mode (none/hash/mask/remove), and consent_exempt list? or a single prescriptive profile (low/medium/high privacy)?
Liam: we discussed profiles in the doc but I worry profiles hide nuance. customers will ask "why was my route sampled?" if we abstract too much.
Shawn: for rollout UX: default to profiles but allow advanced edit per-route. show an inline explanation: "hashing preserves uniqueness but is irreversible"; show examples.
DeployBot: deploy v0.7.12-telemetry to staging at 2026-11-03T15:02:28Z :rocket:
Anya: integration test failure — pipeline rejected our sample because of missing schema version header. Liam can you patch?
Liam: patch coming. also adding a warning banner in Console when redaction_mode==none and sampling_rate>0.001 for prod routes.
Eva: one more requirement from compliance: for PCI/PHI routes we must enforce redaction_mode != none and sampling_rate <= 0.0001 unless contractually allowed. can we gate that with policy engine?
Shawn: yes, policy engine can enforce rules based on route tags. we'll need a migration to tag routes (safety: true, pci: true, phi: true).
Anya: logging team asks whether we can keep 1% of headers (only non-sensitive headers) for debugging. which headers are safe? e.g., accept-language, user-agent ok; authorization must be stripped.
Liam: agreed. current implementation strips Authorization, Cookie, and any header matching /(token|key|auth)/i. we'll add an allowlist in config for safe debug headers.
Eva: please add a short runbook for incident mode: if we escalate a support ticket, ops can temporarily increase sampling for a specific route with an audit entry and TTL. must require 2FA + justification field.
Shawn: ops API already supports on-call overrides but not TTL/audit text. I'll add that to my sprint.
Anya: anything else on telemetry retention? legal wants retention for redacted records 90 days, but raw request metadata 14 days. we need to enforce via lifecycle jobs.
Liam: noted. also adding a console banner to show effective retention per-route when you open the route config.
DeployBot: staged migration of route tags started (5 of 120 routes).
Eva: thanks — can someone add these decisions to the security & privacy doc and ping legal for signoff? I can coordinate.
Liam: will create a short RFC after I land the schema header fix. ETA EOD.
Anya: thx all. adding follow-ups: @Shawn add TTL/audit to ops API, @Liam schema header patch + RFC, @Eva sync with legal.
OpsBot: reminder: any console toggle that affects PII must create an immutable audit event (user, time, before, after).
